_rule: SK-09's token list. It lives in its own fixture, not in tools/snowarch/lib/lint-rules.mjs, for one reason: a file that names a forbidden token is a DETECTOR, and no-legacy-names.test.mjs must exempt it. Exempting one small data file whose entire job is to hold these strings is honest; exempting the whole rules module would blind the ratchet to every other line in it. The `sample` fields exist so tests/lint-negatives.test.mjs can build a broken tree without spelling a forbidden token in a scanned source file — and a test asserts every sample matches its own pattern, so the fixture cannot drift out of self-consistency. Edited by ARC-02-S06 as the sweep widens.
